+import json
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, AsyncIterable, AsyncIterator, Iterable, Iterator, Mapping
+
+import anyio
+from fastapi.encoders import jsonable_encoder
+from starlette.background import BackgroundTask
+from starlette.responses import StreamingResponse
+
+
+@dataclass
+class ServerSentEvent:
+    """
+    A single Server-Sent Event, to be yielded from an endpoint that uses
+    `EventSourceResponse`.
+
+    If `raw_data` is set, it is sent as-is. Otherwise `data` is JSON-encoded.
+    """
+
+    data: Any = None
+    raw_data: str | None = None
+    event: str | None = None
+    id: str | None = None
+    retry: int | None = None
+    comment: str | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if self.data is not None and self.raw_data is not None:
+            raise ValueError("Only one of 'data' or 'raw_data' can be provided")
+
+
+def _format_field(name: str, value: str) -> bytes:
+    lines = value.splitlines() or [""]
+    return b"".join(f"{name}: {line}\n".encode("utf-8") for line in lines)
+
+
+def format_sse_event(item: Any) -> bytes:
+    if not isinstance(item, ServerSentEvent):
+        item = ServerSentEvent(data=item)
+    parts: list[bytes] = []
+    if item.comment is not None:
+        parts.append(_format_field("", item.comment))
+    if item.event is not None:
+        parts.append(_format_field("event", item.event))
+    if item.id is not None:
+        parts.append(_format_field("id", item.id))
+    if item.retry is not None:
+        parts.append(_format_field("retry", str(item.retry)))
+    if item.raw_data is not None:
+        parts.append(_format_field("data", item.raw_data))
+    elif item.data is not None:
+        data = json.dumps(jsonable_encoder(item.data), separators=(",", ":"))
+        parts.append(_format_field("data", data))
+    parts.append(b"\n")
+    return b"".join(parts)
+
+
+class EventSourceResponse(StreamingResponse):
+    """
+    Streaming response with `text/event-stream` media type for Server-Sent Events.
+    Items yielded by the endpoint are formatted as SSE events. Items that are not
+    `ServerSentEvent` instances are sent as JSON in the `data` field.
+    """
+
+    media_type = "text/event-stream"
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        content: Iterable[Any] | AsyncIterable[Any],
+        status_code: int = 200,
+        headers: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
+        media_type: str | None = None,
+        background: BackgroundTask | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        if isinstance(content, AsyncIterable):
+            encoded: AsyncIterator[bytes] | Iterator[bytes] = self._async_encode(
+                content
+            )
+        else:
+            encoded = self._sync_encode(content)
+        super().__init__(
+            content=encoded,
+            status_code=status_code,
+            headers=headers,
+            media_type=media_type,
+            background=background,
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    async def _async_encode(content: AsyncIterable[Any]) -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
+        async for item in content:
+            yield format_sse_event(item)
+            # To allow for cancellation to trigger
+            await anyio.sleep(0)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _sync_encode(content: Iterable[Any]) -> Iterator[bytes]:
+        for item in content:
+            yield format_sse_event(item)
